title: Knowledge Store / Knowledge Base page
desc: The removed Knowledge Store page — embedded-console block generation, list/search/edit, and the document-assignment model. Superseded by the Skills library; torn out in #1460 (reference-context half removed in #1812).

title: Blueprint pipelines + pipeline runtime
desc: The dead blueprint stage-pipeline mechanism + its runtime (handler registry, gates, triggers, builtins), replaced by skills + MCP servers. The UI renderer / render-preview path was deliberately KEPT.

title: Plan grading system
desc: The advisory, non-gating in-app plan-grading layer — pluggable per-section graders, `sectionGrades`, the `scoreColor`/`GradeChip` UI, and the cleanup-grade dead-code scan. No gate, publish, or progression ever consulted a grade; removed end to end in #1459 (with #1468 / #1473).

title: Draft/published on-disk split
desc: Separating unpublished (draft) projects from published ones into different on-disk directories. Reverted in favor of an in-place `projects/<key>/.published` marker — hubs never move — in #922.
